UAObjectType.Description: The in-server Schema Registry root - an xRegistry RegistryType (a FolderType) whose group folders hold schema files. Adds SchemaId-based resolution (GetSchema and the Opaque SchemaId NodeId fast path). Exposed as a well-known object under the Server object; a server does not have to support PubSub to be a schema registry.
An xRegistry GroupType keyed by an OPC UA namespace URI; a folder of schema files for the DataTypes and PublishedDataSets of that namespace.

An xRegistry ResourceType used for both a stable logical schema Resource and each exact schema Version. The logical Resource delegates its file and Version-view metadata to the selected default Version; each Version file holds one concrete schema document (Avro, Apache Arrow or JSON Schema). Adds the OPC UA schema-decoding metadata used by a consumer that resolves a schema from an on-wire fingerprint.

UAObject.Description: A schema group folder (per OPC UA namespace) held by the registry.

UAMethod.Description: Return the schema document and metadata for a raw on-wire SchemaId fingerprint (the method form of the Opaque SchemaId NodeId fast path). An unresolved SchemaId returns the Method Call StatusCode Bad_NotFound rather than an empty result.

UAVariable.Description: The OPC UA namespace URI represented by this schema group (the xRegistry group key). It is the group's source identity: the GroupId is the symbolic identifier constructed from it, and Name is this URI verbatim.

UAObject.Description: A schema file (one DataType/DataSet in one format) held by this group.

UAVariable.Description: Raw on-wire SchemaId fingerprint bytes, computed by the schema format's fingerprint provider (per-format and pluggable; defined for every format including JSON Schema). The schema file is additionally addressable by an Opaque NodeId whose identifier bytes are exactly this value.
SchemaId algorithm name identifying the (canonicalization, hash) used, such as CRC-64-AVRO (Avro), SHA-256/ApacheArrow (Arrow) or SHA-256/JCS (JSON Schema).
The OPC UA DataTypeEncoding name, for example Default Avro or Default Arrow.

xRegistry compatibility mode the schema's versions adhere to, such as NONE, BACKWARD, FORWARD or FULL. This is Resource-level metadata: it is identical across all versions of one schema, and a change that would break it starts a new schema rather than a new version.

xRegistry isdefault: true for the schema's default version - the one served when no explicit version is selected. The default is usually the latest version but MAY be pinned to an earlier one (sticky default).
xRegistry ancestor: the versionid of the version this one derives from, establishing the version lineage. The root version's ancestor is its own VersionId.
OPC UA NodeSet model version label (opcua.modelversion).
PubSub DataSet schema profile only: the Part 14 ConfigurationVersion (opcua.configurationversion) when the schema describes a DataSet. Omitted for a non-PubSub schema registry.
Optional UTC expiry time for mirror/cache mode.

UAObject.Description: Server-wide in-server Schema Registry, a well-known component of the Server object. A server that supports PubSub may additionally reference this object from PublishSubscribe.

UAMethod.Description: Return the schema document and metadata for a raw on-wire SchemaId fingerprint. The functional method on the well-known SchemaRegistry object; an unresolved SchemaId returns the Method Call StatusCode Bad_NotFound.

UAVariable.Description: The name of the subject this schema describes - the DataType BrowseName for a reference DataType schema, or the DataSetName for a PubSub DataSet schema. Together with Format it is the schema's source identity: the ResourceId is the symbolic identifier constructed from the pair, and it is invariant across the schema's versions. It is not the SchemaId, which fingerprints one version's document bytes.

UAObject.Description: Metadata for this namespace, as OPC 10000-5 requires a Server to publish it.

UAObjectType.Description: The typed Versions folder of a logical schema Resource. Every child is a SchemaFileType exact Version.

UAObject.Description: Overrides the inherited Versions component on a logical SchemaFileType so every exact Version is also a SchemaFileType.

UADataType.Description: Abstract format-specific schema content. Does not change the source document bytes.
JSON Schema boolean or object node; subtypes retain keyword semantics.
A JSON Schema boolean schema, not an empty object or a missing schema.
One named map entry. Names are unique and retain their exact spelling.
Ordered, complete map entries.
One named map entry. Names are unique and retain their exact spelling.
Ordered, complete map entries.
JSON Schema 2020-12 standard keywords; unknown vocabularies stay in AdditionalFields.
A complete JSON Schema 2020-12 document.
Avro schema node. 0 is a name/primitive String, 1 a union, 2 an object declaration.
An Avro primitive or named reference; references are not expanded recursively.
Ordered Avro union branches.
Avro field; explicit null default differs from no default.
Named, collection or logical Avro type declaration.
An Avro schema object, including custom properties.
Complete Avro 1.11 schema, preserving named references and union order.
Binary Arrow metadata. Entries preserve order and repeated keys.
Abstract Arrow type. Each concrete family exposes its native type parameters.
A parameter-free Arrow physical type by its canonical name.
Timestamp, time or duration parameters without a textual schema.
Exact Arrow decimal parameters.
Fixed-size binary width.
Arrow field, including exact metadata and nullability.
List, large list, fixed-size list or list-view element.
Ordered Arrow Structure fields.
Map key/value fields, preserving their metadata.
Dense or sparse union with stable ordered type codes.
Dictionary index/value types, not dictionary data.
Run-end encoded type parameters.
Arrow extension identity, binary metadata and native storage type.
Complete Arrow schema content; record-batch data is not a schema.
Uninterpreted JSON-compatible schema format, preserved natively.
Explicit origin, schema entity, format and selected-object identity; never a fragment guess.
One exact schema document revision and its native content.

Field.Name: SelectedContent
Field.Description: The format-owned node selected by Reference.Selector inside the complete Content: a JSON Schema node, Avro declaration or Arrow field. Null without a selection; its references remain relative to Content.

UADataType.Description: Typed schema read outcome. Failure has no document.
Typed schema registration/update with explicit identity and format.

UAObjectType.Description: Native schema selection and registration. Schema document bytes remain available through FileType.

UAMethod.Description: Read the authorized native content of a schema without changing its bytes or fingerprint.

uax:Description.uax:Text: Exact origin, entity/Version, format and object selection.

UAMethod.Description: Validate, serialize and atomically register native schema content; preserve existing Version semantics.

uax:Description.uax:Text: Native content and expected schema epoch.

UAVariable.Description: Revision-bound native schema content; conditionally Mandatory for SREG-NativeSchema.

UADataType.Description: IPC physical type parameters. Kind is the Arrow union tag name. Inactive parameters use zero/empty values.

Field.Name: Code
Field.Description: Arrow Type union tag from the pinned Schema.fbs.

UADataType.Description: Dictionary identity and exact index-type presence. An absent index type means signed Int32.
One IPC field, including the physical Map/RunEnd children. An absent name differs from an empty name.
Complete Arrow IPC Schema message metadata, independent of extension registration and host byte order.
Explicit source identities and exact Version admission. Default selection is requested explicitly.
Native content admission with independently authored namespace and schema subject identities.

UAMethod.Description: Register a native schema without reversing its symbolic identifier.

uax:Description.uax:Text: Explicit namespace, schema subject, Version and native content.

UAMethod.Description: Stage raw schema bytes without changing a committed Version before Close.

uax:Description.uax:Text: Explicit source identity, format and exact Version admission.
Write handle; Close validates and atomically commits the staged document.
